description: This PHP source file defines the class 'TemplateIFrame', a specialized extension of 'TemplateURL' used in SuiteCRM for rendering iframe-based fields within the dynamic fields framework. It includes methods for generating HTML input, labels, detail views, and field definitions related to iframe fields.

classes.name: TemplateIFrame
classes.description: A class extending TemplateURL to implement iframe-specific behavior for dynamic fields in SuiteCRM, including HTML rendering and field definition customization.

methods.name: get_html_edit

methods.name: get_html_label
methods.description: Returns a static label string 'LALALALA' for the iframe field.
